title: Taylor flying cargo jets between Florida and Nassau

tellings.quote: you know, he writes in Launch Fever, his biography about flying these cargo jets back and forth between Florida and Nassau,

plain: Timothy Taylor, a man said to attract UFOs and the subject of one of Michels's episodes, once flew cargo jets back and forth between Florida and Nassau, the capital of the Bahamas. Michels says Taylor writes about this himself in Launch Fever, his biography. He brings it up as part of Taylor's background as a working pilot.
